action_items: No production defects found. Optional (documented limitation, not a bug): captions.instagram/facebook/x are empty strings on the iron-and-oak promo because the Emergent LLM key budget was exhausted at generation time — the fallback path in _generate_all() correctly wrote default headline + description + alt_text + cta + hashtags but left per-platform social captions empty. When LLM budget is topped up, either POST /regenerate on this promo or add a lightweight backfill script to fill captions.instagram/facebook/x without regenerating images.
critical_code_review_comments: featured_maker.py activate_promotion (L348-401): guard order is correct — assets-missing 409 fires before the already-featured 409, and the same-promo-id skip lets re-activation of the currently-live promo bypass the 'replace' requirement (verified: replace=true is only needed for a DIFFERENT promo). LGTM.

Congrats-email dedupe is implemented via `if not promo.get('congrats_email_sent')` with the flag written inside the same try/except after _send — safe against duplicate sends on retries or re-activations. Verified in test_reactivate_iron_with_replace_no_duplicate_email.

_generate_all fallback for captions (L226-230) correctly produces a usable minimum (headline/description/alt_text/cta/hashtags) when the LLM raises, but leaves captions.{instagram,facebook,x} as empty strings. Cosmetic — see action item.

featured_promotions collection has no unique index on the (maker_slug, status='ready') pair, so nothing prevents multiple 'ready' promos for the same maker piling up over iterations. Non-blocking today because activation is admin-gated and only one goes live at a time, but consider an index if this grows.

featured_current collection is treated as a singleton via `delete_many({})` before insert (L367) — race-safe under single-writer admin usage; not safe under concurrent admin clicks (would leave 0 rows briefly). Acceptable for the current MVP scale.
Public /api/featured-maker filters expired features via `ends_at < now_iso()` string compare — works because timestamps are lexicographically-sortable ISO-8601 with the same TZ suffix. Fine.
FeaturedMakerTab.jsx download links correctly use the R2 CDN URLs (verified in browser); no proxying through the API. Good.
Nav.jsx communityMenu items match CommunityPage.jsx TABS + LINK_TABS 1:1 — no drift between the dropdown and the actual routes/tabs.
